Now I'll view one reference per class before revisiting.
Streak_Mosaic_Scsmv reference shows diffuse, irregular yellow streaks on green background — not the clean parallel banding seen in the test image. Let me check Sugarcane_Mosaic_Virus.
Sugarcane_Mosaic_Virus shows diffuse mottled green/yellow — not the clean wide parallel banding. Let me check Yellow_Leaf.
Yellow_Leaf shows whole-leaf browning/yellowing — very different. Let me check Yellow_Spot as my 4th class.

Yellow_Spot shows small discrete yellow dots — clearly different from the test image.

**Summary of evidence:**
- Test image: Clean, wide parallel bands of cream/yellow and green running longitudinally along the leaf — a clear striping pattern, no discrete spots or lesions.
- **Streak_Mosaic_Scsmv** reference: Diffuse irregular yellow streaks on green — closest conceptually (longitudinal streaking), though the reference showed less defined banding.
- **Sugarcane_Mosaic_Virus**: Diffuse mottled green/yellow mosaic — doesn't match the clean parallel bands.
- **Yellow_Leaf**: Whole-leaf browning/tan — doesn't match.
- **Yellow_Spot**: Discrete small spots — doesn't match.

The clean longitudinal banding with alternating cream/yellow and green zones running parallel to leaf veins is most consistent with a streak virus. Among all candidates, **Streak_Mosaic_Scsmv** (Sugarcane streak mosaic virus) produces this kind of parallel streaking pattern along the leaf.
